# PART 3 – Reproduction {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. This part is about the first of the three Rs, and it is the most hands-on stretch of the day. You choose one of the five analysts of our claim and reproduce the value that Multi100 recorded for them, from the public file of the original study, and then we find out why your number is exactly that number. After that we ask what a reproduction needs beyond the data and the code, using the parts of this case that cannot be reproduced exactly, and if there is time you reproduce a second analyst, chosen so that the two of them answered different questions.
:::
